title: First recorded arrangements, for Reuben Reeves
summary: Levy made the first arrangements to be recorded for Reuben Reeves, using consecutive augmented chords. Peyton's small band recorded for Brunswick, and Reeves later went with Cab Calloway.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
